findings.title: Call to undefined no-arg isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() in UsernameForm
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate() calls `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but the only definition in the class hierarchy (UsernamePasswordForm, shown in full in this PR) is `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)`. There is no zero-argument overload anywhere in the changed files, so this does not compile; if the intent was `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser())`, that should be passed explicitly.

findings.title: Passkeys check in UsernameForm silently disabled when authenticator built without a session
findings.body: UsernameForm has a no-arg constructor that leaves `webauthnAuth` null (inherited from UsernamePasswordForm). Any passkeys-enabled check that depends on `webauthnAuth != null` (as the base `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled` does) will return false for instances created via the no-arg constructor, so the re-authentication form will be skipped exactly in the deployments that use the factory-created authenticator, defeating the purpose of this fix. The check needs to work independently of how the authenticator was instantiated (e.g., consult the session/realm policy from the AuthenticationFlowContext).

findings.title: Conditional passkeys UI no longer initialized when no user is set on the login page
findings.body: The new `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(user)` requires `user != null`, and both call sites in `authenticate()` and `challenge()` were changed to use it, whereas the old code called `webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context)` when the user was NOT yet selected. In a browser flow where UsernamePasswordForm is the first/only execution (no prior WebAuthnPasswordless execution), the initial login page will no longer receive the WebAuthn challenge, RP ID, and conditional-UI attributes, so the passkeys autocomplete/'try another way' button disappears for unidentified users. If this regression is intended only for flows that already set up conditional UI earlier, the condition should be documented/tested for the plain UsernamePasswordForm-first flow; otherwise passkey login on the first page is broken.
